description: This file defines the LogWrapper class, which wraps Android's native Log utility to enable logging through a linked chain of LogNode objects. It facilitates outputting logs to multiple targets simultaneously and is part of a custom logging interface implementation.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class that wraps Android's native Log utility, implementing the LogNode interface. It facilitates logging messages and passing them through a chain of LogNode objects.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to which logging data will be passed.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified priority, tag, optional Throwable, and forwards the log to the next node if applicable.
